notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A small patch was made to add the following features:

1) The game now auto-saves after finding each cat.
2) Improves the hint system to zoom onto the cat.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Don't miss the launch sale! Wishlist it now and follow us for updates!
